scientific_integrity.basis: Complete independent enumerations and exact GF(2) boundary-rank calculations for n=2,..,6
scientific_integrity.limitations: Mod-two homology in five finite cases only; not a rational/integral classification, no homotopy type for higher n, and no claim of exhaustive literature novelty.

title: The first mixed-degree mod-two closed-neighborhood homology in a categorical complete-graph product family
